system.text:
This character’s ancestors have mated with something unholy and have tainted the bloodline forever: a curse that will never be lifted, a twisted yoke to bear. The player may choose one trait costing 7 pts or less from the Monstrous Trait List in the Codex. Tainted Legacy also incurs an Inconspicuous penalty. The character always counts as having +2 Ob penalty—his taint has certain odd outward signs.

Type: Dt (die trait). Cost: 5 pts.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 349
